description.narrative: The overall objective of ISAP IV is: To reinforce IGADs corporate performance and operational efficiency and build a coherent and collaborative engagement between IGAD and stakeholders for increased transparency and accountability. The objective of ISAP IV contributes to the attainment of the strategic development objective of the Corporate Development Services Pillar of the IGAD regional strategyfor 2021-25, which is to contribute to transforming IGAD through enhancing its institutional capacity to effectively and efficiently deliver its mandate. Phase four of ISAP comprises two expected outcomes: (1) Corporate performance and operational efficiency of IGAD (Secretariat and Specialised Institutions) enhanced, and (2) Collaborative engagement between IGAD (Secretariat and Specialised Institutions) and stakeholders (Member states, development partners, private sector, civil society organizations and others) for effective delivery of services and obligations established.

Insatsen syftar till att bidra till att adressera IGAD:s institutionella brister, vilka hindrar IGAD från att leverera effektivt på sitt mandat kopplat till pelarna i IGAD:s regionala strategi (2021 - 2025). Det övergripande målet för det strategiska partnerskapet kring ISAP IV:s är att stärka IGAD:s organisatoriska förmåga samt den operationella effektiviteten och bygga upp ett sammanhängande och stärkt samarbete mellan IGAD och intressenter (medlemsstater, givare, privata sektorn, civilsamhällesorganisationer och andra) för ökad transparens och ansvarsskyldighet, såväl som effektiv leverans av tjänster. Genuskvalitet är målinriktat genom detta program, det syftar till att ta itu med befintliga klyftor när det gäller tillämpningen av genusanalys i utformningen av program och införlivande av genuskänsliga indikatorer i IGAD:s övervaknings- och utvärderingsramverk. IGAD planerar också att göra en uthållig opinionsbildning och lobbyverksamhet bland medlemsstaterna för att minska ojämlikhetsklyftan och möta kvinnors och barns prioriteringar och specifika behov. Främjande av jämställdhet och empowerment för kvinnor är således ett av de sju tematiska områden som programmet syftar till att leverera. Det geografiska område som täcks är Afrikas Horn (Djibouti, Etiopien, Kenya, Somalia, Sydsudan, Sudan och Uganda).

The programme aims to contribute to address the key institutional performance gaps still hampering IGAD from delivering its mandate in an effective and efficient manner through the pillars of IGAD’s Regional Strategy (2021-2025). The overall objective of the strategic partnership of ISAP IV is to reinforce IGAD’s corporate performance and operational efficiency and build a coherent and collaborative engagement between IGAD and stakeholders (Member States, development partners, private sector, civil society organizations and others) for increased transparency and accountability, as well as effective delivery of services. Gender quality is targeted through this programme, it aims to address existing gap in terms of the application of gender analysis in the design of programmes and incorporation of gender sensitive indicators in IGAD's monitoring and evaluation frameworks. IGAD also plans to make sustained advocacy and lobbying among the Member States to narrow the inequality gap and meet the priorities and specific needs of women and children. Thus, Promoting Gender Equality and Women Empowerment is one of the seven thematic areas the program aims to deliver. The targeted geographical area is the Horn of Africa (Djibouti, Ethiopia, Kenya, Somalia, South Sudan, Sudan and Uganda).

description.narrative:
From the summative evaluation and the final narrative reports Sida notes that ISAP IV delivered a wide range of institutional results for IGAD, many of which were expected such as strengthened governance systems, improved RBM and fiduciary controls, digital transformation, and enhanced partner coordination while several catalytic or unexpected results also emerged, including accelerated institutional reforms new digital risks, uneven Member State uptake, and gaps between gender systems and gender outcomes.
Expected results achieved
Member states contribution: The reduction of outstanding member states arrears from USD 13.8 million to USD 3,378,362.
Governance reforms Adoption and ratification of the revised IGAD Treaty, strengthening legal and governance frameworks.
Strategic planning Development of IGAD Vision 2050 and the Regional Strategy 20262030.
RBM institutionalization Full embedding of PBMS and ICAF, improving planning, monitoring and corporate performance.
Fiduciary strengthening Multiple clean audit opinions.
Digital transformation Rollout of Microsoft 365, DataMart, EDMS and the Integrated Situation Room.
HR and performance systems Improved staff appraisal coverage and strengthened performance management.
Partner coordination More coherent donor engagement through the ISAP JFA and reduced fragmentation.
Unexpected or catalytic results
Catalytic reforms ISAP IV accelerated broader institutional reforms beyond its original scope.
Digital risks Rapid digitalization created new cybersecurity and systemintegration risks.
Member State engagement Uptake of regional frameworks was weaker than expected at national level. Gender mainstreaming Systems improved, but transformative gender outcomes remained limited.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
